bash: cd /app && python3 - <<'EOF'
import re, collections
txt = open('university_graph.ttl', encoding='utf-8').read()
txt = "\n".join(l.split('#')[0] for l in txt.split('\n'))
txt = re.sub(r'@prefix\s+\w*:\s*<[^>]*>\s*\.', '', txt)
tok_re = re.compile(r'"(?:[^"\\]|\\.)*"(?:\^\^<[^>]*>)?|[^\s.;,]+|[.;,]')
toks = tok_re.findall(txt)
triples=[]; i=0; cur=None
while i < len(toks):
    t=toks[i]
    if t in ('.',';',','):
        if t=='.': cur=None
        i+=1; continue
    if cur is None: cur=t; i+=1; continue
    p=t; i+=1
    while i<len(toks) and toks[i] not in ('.',';'):
        o=toks[i]
        if o==',': i+=1; continue
        triples.append((cur,p,o)); i+=1
def sh(x): return x.split('/')[-1]
cnt=collections.Counter(p for s,p,o in triples)
print("predicates:", dict(cnt))
print("\nisEnrolledIn triples:", sum(1 for s,p,o in triples if p=='uni:isEnrolledIn'))
for s,p,o in triples:
    if p=='uni:isEnrolledIn': print("  ", sh(s), "->", sh(o))
EOF
